out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt a 'rip/tear', 'almost electrified', and a Velcro-like ripping + grinding/vibrational sound while being pulled from the body.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Entity affirmed it was 'God' ('Always!'), 'Jesus' ('Sometimes'), 'Buddha' ('Also yes'), and also 'Krishna, Jah, and Allah' ('And MORE').
arrival.other_being_detail: Primary guide-like entity: brighter, mostly featureless light-body with rays of gold light; telepathic; 'smiling... like an old friend'. Later, multiple larger 'angelic' helper entities counseling souls 'in-between'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described a bright white/gold 'room' with no walls (Neo/Morpheus-like). Later a higher plane with 'far more colors, even ones I had never seen', and a 'school' with desks, books, halls, and long file cabinets.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: A larger helper entity threw a 'bowling ball' sized violet/red/white energy sphere into his 'spirit-chest', after which he opened his physical eyes as the nurse performed a sternum rub.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He understood he was 'supposed to be learning to heal' and to 'raise other people's vibrations' / 'help heal and awaken others' in a 'dark time'; also told to 'wake up... sleeping Warriors'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Stroke with blood clots (one later described as heading toward heart, brain, and lungs).

person_demographics.nationality_ethnicity: Part Native American and Polish (via mother); father American military (raised by atheist father).
person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Raised primarily by an 'athiest, militant dad' in early childhood; later exposed to stepmother's New-Age spirituality.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Describes himself as an 'Omnist'; had 'lost [his] spiritual way quite a bit again' prior to the stroke.
person_demographics.occupation: Sales; also moonlighting as door/security at a pool hall/bar/music venue.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived multiple 'planes/frequencies'; 'school' / Akashic-records-like learning; heard many dying/comatose souls calling for help; received specific health instructions (water/aspirin/citrus peels).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in hospital → encounter with benevolent guide/light-being → bright room conversation → rapid Q&A / life-flash-like learning and past-life flashes → shift ('periscope') to higher plane with many souls and larger helper entities → external-assisted return via energy sphere → awakening in body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Claims perception of a missing/absent 'cord' between astral and physical body; described a higher plane where he could hear thousands of souls dying/in comas; larger helper entities appeared 'shorthanded'; entity retrieved and threw a violet/red/white energy sphere to force return; received specific self-treatment instructions (water, aspirin, citrus peels) that he applied in hospital.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I saw my Soul-self, leave my physical self."; "I could see everything happening around me, in spherical, 360 degree vision."; "You're OK, you have some time... let's go for a walk and chat."; "Are you God?" — "Always!"; "Are you also Jesus?" — "Sometimes……"; "Are you also Buddha?" — "Also yes!"; "It's not your time yet."
